name: Waldorf Astoria Riviera Maya
insider_take: This all-inclusive luxury resort brings Waldorf Astoria's legendary hospitality to Mexico's Caribbean coast, where ancient Mayan ruins meet pristine white sand beaches.
whats_special: The resort sits on a secluded stretch of Playa del Carmen's coastline, featuring overwater bungalows - a rarity in Mexico. Each suite comes with a dedicated butler service, and the property houses the region's only tequila and mezcal sommelier program. The resort's spa incorporates traditional Mayan healing rituals with indigenous ingredients like cacao and honey.
pro_tip: Book the cenote excursion through the concierge - the hotel has exclusive access to a private cenote just 10 minutes away, perfect for an otherworldly swimming experience without the crowds.
dont_miss: The sunset dinner at Isla, the resort's overwater restaurant, where Chef Ricardo Muñoz serves contemporary Mexican cuisine literally above the Caribbean Sea. Also explore nearby Tulum ruins (45 minutes away) - the only Mayan archaeological site built directly on the ocean.
pros: Legendary Waldorf Astoria luxury service and amenities
Pristine beachfront location on Riviera Maya
Multiple gourmet dining venues and culinary experiences
cons: Remote location requires travel time to Cancun attractions
